title: Topic 6.5: Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities

pages.lesson:
LESSON: WORK TALENTS, GIFTS AND ABILITIES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living Today
Topic 6.5: Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities
2. Practise Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities in the examples.
2. Explain Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities
2. Practise Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
